title: Handler init/2 returns a bare Req, violating the cowboy_handler contract — every route crashes its request process
evidence: src/books_http_handler.erl:5,12 — init/2 clauses tail-call reply/3 (line 23) and book_route/3, all of which return cowboy_req:reply/4's value (a bare Req map). cowboy 2.12.0 (rebar.lock) cowboy_handler:execute/2 matches only {ok,Req,State} | {Mod,Req,State} | {Mod,Req,State,Opts}; a bare map raises a try_clause and the request process is terminated. Affects R1,R4,R5,R6,R8,R10. HTTP layer is untested (test/books_api_tests.erl exercises decode_book/books_db directly), so test_coverage=1.0 despite no route serving reliably.
suggestion: Return {ok, Req2, State} from init/2, where Req2 is the Req returned by cowboy_req:reply.

title: GET /books calls cowboy_req:qs_val/2, which does not exist in Cowboy 2.x — R2/R3 never serve
evidence: src/books_http_handler.erl:10 calls cowboy_req:qs_val(<<"author">>,Req); rebar.config:2 and rebar.lock pin cowboy 2.12.0, where qs_val/2 was removed in Cowboy 2.0 (replaced by parse_qs/1 or match_qs/2). Any GET /books (R2, R3) raises undefined function before any reply is sent.
suggestion: Replace with cowboy_req:parse_qs/1 or match_qs/2 and map a missing author to the undefined/no-filter case books_db:list/1 already handles.

title: No test exercises the HTTP layer, so two fatal runtime bugs pass unflagged
evidence: test/books_api_tests.erl:4-17 — the 3 tests call books_http_handler:nonempty/1, decode_book/1 and books_db CRUD directly; none start Cowboy or issue an HTTP request, so the init/2 contract bug and the qs_val undef are never caught. test_coverage=1.0 (scores.json) reflects only this subset.
suggestion: Add an integration test that starts the listener and issues real HTTP requests against each route.
